voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Alas-dos ng madaling-araw, may batang naglalaro sa ilalim ng mga mesa namin.
lines.beat_before: hook: under a desk, chair wheels; small bare feet run past between the desks

lines.text: Call center agent ako noon. Graveyard shift, sa isang lumang building.
lines.beat_before: the floor at 2 a.m. from above the cubicles: a few agents in headsets, monitors glowing

lines.text: Jun-Jun ang tawag sa kanya ng mga matagal na. Huwag mo raw siyang pansinin.
lines.beat_before: the senior agent beside me leans back, looks at me, then down at the floor

lines.text: Sa pagitan ng mga tawag, naririnig ko siyang tumatakbo sa likod ko.
lines.beat_before: my POV at my screen between calls; behind me a chair rolls by itself

lines.text: Sa itim na monitor, nakita ko siya. Nakaupo sa paanan ko.
lines.beat_before: the dark second monitor: my face in it, and at my feet a small figure, head bowed

lines.text: Nag-resign ako. Lumipat ng kumpanya, ibang building.
lines.beat_before: my cleared desk on the old floor; my chair turns by itself toward the exit

lines.text: Unang gabi sa bagong floor, may humila sa kable ng headset ko.
lines.beat_before: the new floor, other colours; my headset cable on the desk, pulled down in jerks

lines.text: Pagsilip ko sa ilalim ng mesa... nandoon siya. Sumama pala siya.
lines.beat_before: I lean down to look under the desk: dark, then him, hugging his knees
